title: Arthur Cayley: Collected Mathematical Papers, Source-Checked Modern LaTeX Slice Readers
description:
Dedicated Arthur Cayley author record for source-checked modern LaTeX slice readers, repaired diagrams, TeX sources, and continuation manifests. The current reader surface includes a complete source-checked Volume I reader and volume-level slice readers for most collected-papers volumes. The 2026-06-03 refresh repairs several scan-checked formula/table defects in Volumes VI, VII, VIII, XI, and XIII and refreshes the source/manifest supplement.

Status at a glance. [#######---] public reader coverage: thousands of rendered pages across current volume readers; [######----] scan-faithful cleanup: many diagrams and known malformed areas repaired, with the remaining open work concentrated in a few dense table zones tracked in the manifest; [#########-] provenance: source TeX chunks, scans, and repair notes preserved through GitHub and the main project record.
notes: Dedicated Cayley author DOI. The latest refresh updates repaired volume reader PDFs and the source/manifest supplement while keeping large raw provenance on the main preservation record.
